company.shortDescription: Launchpad Toys is a computer software company that develops digital toys and tools that empower kids to create, learn, and share ideas.
company.description:
Launchpad Toys is a computer software company that develops digital toys and tools that empower kids to create, learn and share their ideas through play. It features Toontastic, ToonTube, Toontastic Jr. Pirates, and Toontastic Jr. Shrek.

The company was founded in 2010 and headquartered in San Francisco, California.
